# R6.10 — PROXY-CORE: hh-model-proxy + hh-l1-canon/1 (manifest 263)

Base `origin/main` @ `73c5694c` (R6.9 tip). **mergePolicy: OPERATOR.**

## What lands

**`hh-model-proxy`** (`hharness-hosting::proxy` + binary; §4.1–§4.3;
AR-08) — the runner-controlled model mediator:

- Json control channel on stdio (`configure`/`register_slot`/
  `revoke_slot`/`status`/`stop`); downward deps only; hosting tier
  still removable (no crate gains an edge into it).
- Per-slot token gate (constant-time match; shared `mint_token` home
  in `hh-secrets::tokens`); `security.credential.bound`/`revoked`
  rows.
- §4.2 route table — chat + messages pass-through via `forward_raw`
  same-dialect, `GET /v1/models`, `count_tokens` → typed 404, all else
  `refused_route`.
- Declared `hh.proxy.lane/1` field policy — `tool_choice`/auto strip
  with notice, non-auto refuse; recursive `cache_control` + `metadata`
  strip; `n>1`/`logprobs`/`logit_bias`/Responses-continuity refuse;
  `budget_tokens` forwarded recorded-not-enforced; `stream` → typed
  `unsupported{release_mode:buffered_heartbeat}` (R6.11's leg).
- Path-qualified `GenParamPolicy` (AR-10): `pin` + `params_scope`;
  `model` + effort-path pinned, requested/applied recorded.
- §4.3 ledger order end-to-end: `requested` → `reserved` (fixture
  bound only; else typed step-2 refusal) → `attempt.*` → blobs →
  terminal → one-batch `cost.attributed`+`budget.released` → release.
  **Durable-before-visible** — the kill-point leg injects a durability
  fault; the cell sees no released byte.
- `leak_scan` before every blob deposit vs {Ollama key, slot tokens}
  — key hit refuses the write and stops the phase (`refused_phase_stopped`).
  This closes the receipt leg of `DF-R6.7-1` (cell-env leg stays with
  R6.16).
- Honest usage/cost: provider `usage` → `TokenDecomposition` → priced;
  absent `cache_read`/`reasoning` record `available:false`, never `0`.

**`hh-l1-canon/1`** (`hharness-wire::l1_canon`): C01–C07 masked-diff
comparison over the one canonicalizer; golden + adjacent-mutation
battery per rule; versioned (`L1_CANON_VERSION`) for the post-gate
allowlist-change rule.

Also: `PJson` float-preserving provider codec; `forward_raw_method`
GET leg; `measurement.provider.usage.observed` +
`measurement.cost.reconciled` class registration.

## Deviation (recorded)

~4.1k changed lines vs the ≤1700 split trigger — one coherent
proxy+canon slice (R6.8 ~5.3k precedent); serial upstream handling
(strictly stronger than the 3-way bound; FIFO order still recorded).
`control.budget.consumed` intentionally not separately emitted — the
fold treats `cost.attributed` as the charge (both would double-count).
